points.label: Named subject
points.left: The psalm names Joseph as the man sent ahead.

points.label: Continuing action
points.left: The LORD calls famine, sends, tests, and releases through the remembered sequence.
points.right: Wisdom does not forsake, descends, remains, raises, and vindicates.
